title: Verify the complete e127 compact OBJ runtime filter
changes: Run the previously incomplete compact OBJ full runtime filter with the corrected selector oracle and e127-d126 expectations.
validation: The complete filter passed under Wine: 102 owned bytes, mixed boundaries, transactional tamper rejection and interpreter/native full-state-clock equality for selectors 0, 1, 2 and 256; 14 typed native bytes.
All 97 prior resources matched; the test asserts 100 e127 resources and the retained manifest independently confirms 100. Guarded inputs were unchanged and successful scratch was removed.
limitations: The test result JSON contains a stale hard-coded resources value of 98; use its assertion and retained manifest for the actual count. Test artifact matched the selected ROM-data source; six unrelated files changed since its snapshot.

The first sandbox Wine setup failed on a read-only server lock before the test; its two owned leases were released following an elevated host process check. No native Windows, Linux, USA, new ordinary scene or performance claim.
